name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you face a trial of communion with the elements. You earn the water totem rites and make the sapta needed to perceive elemental spirits.
As a dwarf, you can seek guidance from elemental mentors such as Norric Lochthane across Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance shaman, you seek communion with water spirits across the eastern lands, between Loch Modan and Westfall.

faq.answer: Norric Lochthane mentors candidates in Loch Modan as they seek communion with the elements. He oversees the preparations and rites for earning the water totem.
Hervdana Saegrund lives with her family in a cave by the southern falls in the Wetlands. She guides aspiring shamans and blesses sacred water for making water sapta.
A sapta is a draught prepared with sacred water. Drinking it lets a shaman perceive elusive water spirits in natural pools.
faq.q: What is a sapta used for?

faq.answer: Stendel’s Pond lies in Westfall near Moonbrook. Water spirits dwell there, and a shaman seeks them after drinking a prepared sapta.
The Vial of Purest Water holds blessed water needed to brew the water sapta and perform the rites for earning a water totem. Norric warns that every drop matters.
faq.q: Why is the Vial of Purest Water important?

faq.answer: The water totem rites are spiritual trials that attune shamans to water. Shamans show respect and balance before receiving a water totem.
faq.q: What are the water totem rites?

sections.body: You seek harmony with water through patience and reverence. Hervdana blesses the water you gather, and you carry it to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
sections.title: The Path to the Water Totem

sections.body: Norric Lochthane uses Hervdana’s blessed water to brew a water sapta. The draught lets you perceive the water spirits at Stendel’s Pond near Moonbrook. Every drop matters, and the dampened stopper has its place in the rites.
sections.title: Birthing the Sapta

summary: At Loch Modan, seekers prepare to commune with water spirits. Hervdana blesses pure water for Norric Lochthane as aspiring shamans draw nearer to the water totem rites.
